raja: Starting bring-up for asia-south1 inference cluster next week. We need 40 A100-80GB equivalent GPUs reserved for a 2-week onboarding window. Can someone lead quota requests + procurement? Needed by 2026-03-26.

kelsey: I'll take point. Quick checklist: 1) confirm instance types and region 2) open quota request(s) with provider 3) create capacity reservation (if supported) 4) commit budget / PO 5) infra tickets + TF changes 6) validation runbook :white_check_mark:

raja: Instance mix: 20 x a2-megagpu-16g (GCP) or p4d.24xlarge equivalent on AWS. Preferred: GCP in asia-south1, failover in asia-east1. Cost estimate attached (internal link) :link:

maria: For GCP, we need both "GPUS (all regions)" quota increase and "CPUs (asia-south1)". Also quota for sole-tenant if using reservations. I'll file the console request and flag account rep. Template below.

maria: ```Subject: Quota increase for asia-south1 - urgent onboarding
Hi team,
Project: redwood-prod
Region: asia-south1
Resource: GPUs (A100 80GB) - request +40
Current quota: 8
Requested quota: 48
Start date: 2026-03-24
Reason: New inference cluster bring-up for Redwood Inference; pre-burn for onboarding testing. Contact: maria@redwood.com
Thanks,
Maria
```

oliver: For AWS we should open a Support case + ask for Capacity Reservations in ap-south-1. Also request On-Demand limit increase for p4d. I'll queue a PR to our terraform module to add a `capacity_reservation` resource and tag it `bringup/asia-south1`.

kelsey: Ops checklist (internal):
- Create ticket in INFRA-OPS with estimate + cloud-case ids
- Attach finance approval + PO number
- Create TF branch: region vars + reservation resources
- Plan/apply in a `canary` account first
- Run validation: smoke inference, kv-cache perf, p95 latency test
- Create handoff doc + assign oncall rotation

I'll post the TF snippet for reservation.

kelsey: ```hcl
resource "google_compute_reservation" "asia_res" {
  name = "asia-south1-a100-bringup"
  region = "asia-south1"
  specific_machine_type = "a2-megagpu-16g"
  specific_reservation_affinity = "ANY"
  count = 20
}
```

raja: thumbs up. Maria, please copy that GCP template into the support console and ping the account rep. Oliver, tag me on the TF PR. Deadline: have tickets + reservation created by EOD tomorrow.

maria: Filed GCP request, case ID GC-20260320-4521, flagged account rep (cc: cloud-sales). Added note to ask for temporary reservation hold or "pre-reservation" for 2 weeks. Also requested CPU quota.

oliver: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/infra/terraform/+/1234 and added `bringup` tag. Plan succeeded in canary. Will request apply window at 02:00 UTC to minimize impact.

deploy-bot: Deployment plan scheduled: infra-apply at 2026-03-21T02:00:00Z. Runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/infrastructure/bringup-gpu

kelsey: Validation tests to run post-apply:
- allocate test model, 10 warmup requests @ 512 tokens
- run 1h load @ 40rps to verify autoscaler behaviour
- check KV cache warm hit rate > 70%
- confirm costs reporting in console and alert if > 10% estimated

I'll own validation and handoff.

raja: Great. Assigning oncall rotation to @oliver and @kelsey for the first 72 hours. Also set fallback policy to route to asia-east1 with reduced batch sizes.

maria: Updated the INFRA-OPS ticket with GC-20260320-4521 and the AWS case AWS-20260320-998. Finance confirmed short-term commit available; PO #PO-9876.

kelsey: cool. If anyone runs into quotas blocked by provider, escalate to cloud rep and tag `@raja` and `@maria`. :thumbsup:
